import java.util.Scanner;

    static final int N = 577;
    static int n, m, Mod;
    static long[] dp = new long[N], dp2 = new long[N];
    static long[][] C = new long[N][N], res = new long[N][N], res2 = new long[N][N];

    static long getSum(int l, int r) {
        long sum = ((long)(l + r) * (r - l + 1)) / 2;
        return sum % Mod;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        Mod = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            C[0][i] = 1;
        }
        C[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
            C[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                C[j][i] = (C[j][i - 1] + C[j - 1][i - 1]) % Mod;
            }
        }

        dp[0] = 1;
        dp2[0] = 0;

        for (int len = 1; len <= n; len++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
                long sm = getSum(1, i - 1) + getSum(1, len - i);
                int cnt = len + 1;

                long term1 = (dp[i - 1] * cnt) % Mod;
                long term2 = (dp[len - i]) % Mod;
                long c = C[i - 1][len - 1];

                dp[len] = (dp[len] + (term1 * term2 % Mod) * c) % Mod;

                long term3 = (dp2[i - 1] * cnt) % Mod;
                long term4 = (dp[len - i]) % Mod;
                long c2 = C[i - 1][len - 1];

                dp2[len] = (dp2[len] + (sm * term3) % Mod * c) % Mod;
                dp2[len] = (dp2[len] + (dp2[len - i] * cnt) % Mod * term4 % Mod * c) % Mod;
                long term5 = (dp2[i - 1] * cnt) % Mod;
                long term6 = (dp[len - i]) % Mod;
                long c3 = C[i - 1][len - 1];

                dp2[len] = (dp2[len] + (dp2[len - i] * cnt) % Mod * term6 % Mod * c) % Mod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m && j <= i; j++) {
                res[i][j] = res[i - 1][j];
                res2[i][j] = res2[i - 1][j];
                for (int h = 1; h < j; h++) {
                    long c = C[h][j];
                    res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * c) % Mod;
                    res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res2[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * c) % Mod;
                    res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp2[h] % Mod * c) % Mod;
                }
                res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + dp[j]) % Mod;
                res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + dp2[j]) % Mod;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(res2[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
